lines: Initiation and the rest must be told — it is said;
so to set forth initiation's nature, first
the to-be-done bath is taught.
sanskrit_cite: dīkṣādikaṃ vaktavyam iti uktam ato dīkṣāsvarūpanirūpaṇārthaṃ prāk kartavyaṃ snānam upadiśyate

lines: Bathing is called purity —
and purity is entering the Supreme Lord's own form.
sanskrit_cite: snānaṃ ca śuddhatā ucyate śuddhatā ca parameśvarasvarūpasamāveśaḥ

lines: Washing off turbidity — that indeed is purity;
and turbidity, even in That whose sole form is That,
is the conceit of admixing a form of alien nature.
sanskrit_cite: kāluṣyāpagamo hi śuddhiḥ kāluṣyaṃ ca tadekarūpe 'pi atatsvabhāvarūpāntarasaṃvalanābhimānaḥ

lines: Here — in the self whose pith is free bliss, consciousness alone,
or everywhere in the world as well — the conceit
of admixing another-formed reality is impurity;
that, too, is washed out by great-Bhairava immersion:
suddenly for some — for others awaiting further means.
sanskrit_cite: tad iha svatantrānandacinmātrasāre svātmani viśvatrāpi vā tadanyarūpasaṃvalanābhimānaḥ aśuddhiḥ sā ca mahābhairavasamāveśena vyapohyate so 'pi kasyacit jhaṭiti bhavet kasyāpi upāyāntaramukhaprekṣī

lines: Therein too — by one-, two-, threefold division,
whole or part; somewhere, for someone, sometime,
and so from assurance-attainment: difference is manifold.
sanskrit_cite: tatrāpi ca ekadvitryādibhedena samastavyastatayā kvacit kasyacit kadācit ca tathā āśvāsopalabdheḥ vicitro bhedaḥ

lines: And eightfold: in earth-, water-, wind-, fire-, sky-,
moon-, sun-, and self-formed places — the eight forms
made into Supreme-Lord forms by mantra-placement's majesty;
by identity, in the body entered by the Supreme, for anyone,
immersion in the Supreme arises — though from gladness
of bathing-clothes and the rest it becomes the means: thus told.
As in revered Ānanda and the rest: firmness, nourishment, vigor,
impurity-burning, pervasion, creation-, maintenance-capacity, non-difference —
chief fruits, here and there, from the mantra placed in each,
assuming that and that form.
sanskrit_cite: sa ca aṣṭadhā kṣitijalapavanahutāśanākāśasomasūryātmarūpāsu aṣṭāsu mūrtiṣu mantranyāsamahimnā parameśvararūpatayā bhāvitāsu tādātmyena ca dehe parameśvarasamāviṣṭe śarīrādivibhāgavṛtteḥ caitanyasyāpi parameśvarasamāveśaprāptiḥ kasyāpi tu snānavastrādituṣṭijanakatvāt parameśopāyatām etīti uktaṃ ca śrīmadānandādau dhṛtiḥ āpyāyo vīryaṃ maladāho vyāptiḥ sṛṣṭisāmarthyaṃ sthitisāmarthyam abhedaś ca ity etāni teṣu mukhyaphalāni teṣu teṣu upāhitasya mantrasya tattadrūpadhāritvāt
notes: 'śrīmadānandādau' held as glossed (person-or-joy locus unresolved; L0 clean)

lines: Now heroes' rule — the distinction:
battle-dust, hero-water, great wind, hero-ash,
the cremation-ground sky — sun and moon placed in them,
the self undiscriminating.
sanskrit_cite: vīroddeśena tu viśeṣaḥ tad yathā raṇareṇuḥ vīrāmbhaḥ mahāmarut vīrabhasma śmaśānanabhaḥ tadupahitau candrārkau ātmā nirvikalpakaḥ

lines: Again too, as outer-inner twoness:
by oneness with the outward-worshipped mantra,
made of That — plunging here, there: thus told.
sanskrit_cite: punar api bāhyābhyantaratayā dvitvam bahirupāsyamantratādātmyena tanmayīkṛte tatra tatra nimajjanam ity uktam

lines: But the bliss-substance, abiding as the hero's support,
by looking, having made it Śiva — right there,
the mantra-circle's worship; thence by that very one,
body-and-breath deity-circle satisfied: thus the chief bath.
sanskrit_cite: viśeṣas tu ānandadravyaṃ vīrādhāragataṃ nirīkṣaṇena śivamayīkṛtya tatraiva mantracakrapūjanam tataḥ tenaiva dehaprāṇobhayāśritadevatācakratarpaṇam iti mukhyaṃ snānam

lines: Inward, thus: by holding earth-and-other-formed forms —
here, there, in the earthen and other circles —
the state of being made of That.
sanskrit_cite: ābhyantaraṃ yathā tattaddharādirūpadhāraṇayā tatra tatra pārthivādau cakre tanmayībhāvaḥ
